captions.detailed: A dual-actuation dropper seatpost made of matte black metal, featuring a long round outer tube and a telescoping inner tube. At the top of the inner tube is a rectangular saddle clamp mount. In the middle, a collar clamp ring is fitted with two symmetrical side-lever actuators that pivot on revolute hinges.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a dual-actuation dropper seatpost in CadQuery. The assembly must include a round outer tube, a telescoping inner tube with a prismatic joint, a top saddle clamp, and two side-lever actuators that pivot on revolute hinges attached to the collar clamp ring. Apply a matte black material to all components.
captions.factory: Construct the outer tube using a cylinder primitive, adding a stepped collar ring at the top. Model the inner tube as a slightly smaller cylinder that slides prismatically inside the outer tube, topped with a blocky saddle clamp structure. Create the two side levers using boolean operations on boxes and cylinders, and attach them symmetrically to the sides of the collar ring using revolute joints.
